notes.title: Pawn launches in 7 hours
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26907758/b7337d986b28ce462f149d12b217d47b246fb73a.jpg[/img]

Thanks to your support, Pawn will be released around 10 A.M. PST. today !

What started as an indie side project is now a fully playable game, and we cannot find the words to express our gratitude to everyone who greenlighted our concept and added the game on their wishlists.

Pawn being our very first game, we're aware we still have a whole lot to learn, hence feel free to share opinions on the forum and maybe post a review on the store page.

notes.title: Beta's complete, thank you !
notes.content:
Dear "Pawners", 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26907758/57011416b63c8f3b50297b3055a530f5afca818f.jpg[/img]

Beta is closed and all the bugs have been fixed. A few gameplay enhancements have been added, and many more will come once the game is released. 
We're not an AAA company so there won't be a 7Gb Day-One Patch, but improvements, side stories and standalone mini games will periodically be added to the game or as Free DLCs.

A special thanks to the users who took the time to tell us about bugs and typos especially Dharma, Icycrust and Shining_Falcon.
See y'all on Dec. 9 !
